info.title: Kamitsubaki City Under Construction
info.synopsis: Sette anni dopo che l'umanità è stata devastata da una grande catastrofe, un faro di scienza e prosperità sorge a Kamitsubaki City. Ma nell'ombra si celano i Tesseractor, mostri nati dall’oscurità del cuore umano. Solo le Witchling, cinque ragazze con voci che sprigionano magia, si oppongono a loro. Con ogni nota, combattono non solo per proteggere la pace della città, ma anche per guarire un mondo spezzato.

episodes.synopsis: As the RD struggles to keep the outbreak under control, Sekai rushes to save the people of her old church.

episodes.title: Fragment
episodes.synopsis: The witchlings debate the fallout from their last mission while the RD Chief struggles to understand.

episodes.title: Malice
episodes.synopsis: The witchlings are left reeling from a sudden betrayal as disappearances rise around the city.

episodes.title: Familier
episodes.synopsis: The witchlings are forced to run from suspicious townspeople while trying to find and stop Kugel.

episodes.title: Memory Egg
episodes.synopsis: Exploring Kugel's memories forces the witchlings to confront a shocking truth about their world.

episodes.title: Phenomenon
episodes.synopsis: As time ticks down for Kamitsubaki CIty, Kafu confronts the forces preventing her from singing.

episodes.title: Blackout
episodes.synopsis: Maxwell prepares to unleash hell on Kamitsubaki City, but the witchlings are far from a united front.

episodes.title: Desire
episodes.synopsis: The situation grows even more dire for the witchlings as Maxwell's plan comes to fruition.

episodes.title: Artificial Real
episodes.synopsis: Kafu finds herself in a strange situation following her last, desperate song.

episodes.title: Regenerate
episodes.synopsis: The girls return to Kamitsubaki City for their final confrontation with Maxwell.
